messages:
Alex: Morning folks — handing over to @Jamie for the 06:00–14:00 shift. Quick TL;DR: low traffic overnight, 2 minor errors on the embed pipeline, canary -> stable deploy finished. Watchlist and action items below. :coffee:
ops-bot: Deploy finished: canary v3.2.1 -> stable. No rollbacks. (deploy-id: dpl-8742)
Jamie: Thanks — any perf regressions after canary?
Alex: Nope, latency p50 ~ 45ms, p95 ~ 230ms in canary region. Quick check command: ```monitor query --metric=response_latency --range=1h --group=region```
Maria: Heads up: KV cache evictions spiked at 03:42 UTC in eu-west-1 (~15% jump). Likely larger sequence lengths from a customer batch. Watching until 09:00. :eyes:
Ryan: Left a note in infra PR #412 about bumping max-kv-size to 1.2GB for dedicated pools. If merged, expect short rolling restarts. cc @Jamie
Jamie: Can you link the PR? I'll hold off restarts until after 11:00 unless urgent.
Ryan: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/412 — depends on canary metrics. Not urgent.
Alex: Action item for @Jamie: run KV eviction baseline check at shift start and post results here. Command: `./scripts/kv-check --region eu-west-1 --summary`
Jamie: On it. Also pinging @Maria re: embed errors — any Sentry traces?
Maria: Two related traces in Sentry: embed/worker timeouts, stack shows await client.embed(req) retry loop. I increased worker timeout from 5s -> 8s in canary last night. Monitoring.
Alex: FYI: Customer "X" has traffic spike scheduled 10:30 UTC. Route policy keeps them on dedicated. If p95 > 500ms, flip route to fallback model (policy id: route-fb-2).
Jamie: Noted. I'll set an alert at 10:25 to watch p95 for their tenant. Who owns the toggle? @Ryan?
Ryan: I can flip. Leave a message here if it crosses threshold.
ops-bot: Alert created: p95_latency_tenant-X > 500ms -> notify #eng-oncall (alert-id: a-9932).
Jamie: KV check done: evictions: 1.2%, hit_rate: 98.6%, top_keys: 3 — seems stable rn. Posting raw: {"evictions":1.2,"hit_rate":98.6}
Maria: Thanks. I'll watch embed retries; if they exceed 5% escalate.
Alex: Misc notes: - No active incidents. - CR pings: please review infra #410 (autoscaler tuning) and infra #411 (metric naming). @Ryan @Maria please triage today. - Rotation: I swap with @Jamie next Tue AM (rota updated).
Jamie: Acknowledged. If anything pops, call the bridge first then page.
Maria: :thumbsup: Good handoff. I'll update the runbook entry for embed timeouts with the new value.
Alex: Leaving handoff at 06:02 UTC. Thanks team — good luck. :rocket:
